# 




This datapack brings an exciting challenge to your Minecraft world. A specially equipped skeleton with a leather hat becomes a relentless assassin that hunts you down. If the skeleton moves more than 40 blocks away from you, it automatically teleports back to continue the hunt. The challenge is accompanied by a built-in stopwatch that displays the elapsed time in hours, minutes, and seconds. The clock can be started, stopped, and reset, and it ends automatically when the Ender Dragon is defeated or the player dies.

⌨️ Commands•/function huntig_skeleton:challenge_start - Starts the challenge and spawns the skeleton (also starts the timer).•/function huntig_skeleton:timer_start – Starts the stopwatch.•/function huntig_skeleton:timer_stop – Stops the stopwatch.•/function huntig_skeleton:timer_reset – Resets the stopwatch.

💡 Tip: Ideal for speedrunners, content creators, or anyone who wants to experience Minecraft in a new way. The hunter shows no mercy – are you ready?
